title: Russian Drone Strike Kills Two in Kyiv Residential Building Despite Trump Energy Ceasefire
detail: A Russian drone strike hit a residential apartment building in Kyiv, killing two people. The attack occurred despite the so-called 'energy ceasefire' announced by former US President Trump, highlighting the continued Russian targeting of Ukrainian civilians and infrastructure.

title: Poland Arrests Two Turkish Nationals for Russia-Linked Arson at Starlink Ground Station
detail: Polish authorities arrested two Turkish nationals suspected of setting fire to a Starlink satellite ground station in what officials described as a Russia-linked sabotage operation. The incident is the latest in an alleged Russian covert sabotage campaign targeting NATO infrastructure, raising concerns about hybrid warfare operations against alliance communications.

media.caption: Polish authorities arrested two Turkish nationals over a fire at a Starlink ground station in an alleged Russia-linked sabotage operation

title: Ukraine Reports Russia Lost 1,390 Troops in Single Day
detail: Ukraine's military reported that Russian forces suffered approximately 1,390 personnel losses in a single day, according to Ukrinform citing the Ukrainian General Staff. This figure represents one of the higher single-day loss tallies reported during the conflict and underscores the continued intensity of ground combat operations.

title: EU Intensifies War Support for Ukraine Following Trump-Putin Deal
detail: The European Union has moved to intensify its military and financial support for Ukraine in the wake of a Trump-Putin agreement that analysts say has sidelined US engagement. European capitals have signaled that the bloc will step up weapons deliveries and economic aid to fill the gap left by a reduced American commitment, marking a significant shift in transatlantic burden-sharing for Ukraine's defence.

title: Twelve US Senators Urge Trump to Abandon Russia Diesel Export Deal
detail: Twelve US senators, including six Republicans, sent a letter to President Trump urging him to abandon a proposed diesel export deal with Russia. The bipartisan opposition signals growing congressional resistance to any economic arrangements that could benefit Russia while the war in Ukraine continues.
